_about: Flight locomotion (docs/animation/flight-locomotion.md). A free fighter in the air moves with weight: an acceleration lean on a spring that overshoots (shoulders lead, hips and head follow), a braking flare when he stops hard from speed (the brake skid's own pose, mixed in at a part weight), a dash's anticipation (a short coil with the weight back, over `dash_ticks`, that the surge then takes forward), a bank into curves (the body rolls about its forward axis and leans into the turn) and a hover that breathes. All of it is read from the sim's velocity and the dash input and never writes the sim. `lean`: stiff and damp are the spring's, `max_deg` the forward lean at `acc_ref` (`back_scale` of it going back) units a second squared of forward acceleration, `lag` how much of it the pelvis, neck and head take (the pelvis opposite). `flare`: `pose` is mixed in at `w` when he decelerates past `brake_ref` from over `min_speed`, in over `ticks`. `dash`: the anticipation. `bank`: `roll_deg` at `omega_ref` radians a second of the velocity's heading, from `min_speed`. `hover`: the breath (`rate_hz`, `chest_deg`, `shoulder_deg`, `bob` units) while slower than `still_speed` and off the ground; `fighters`: a roster id's own breath (`rate`, `depth`: the Protagonist's slow and wide, the Anti-hero's quicker and tighter) and lean (`lean` its scale, `damp` the spring's damping scale: the Protagonist floaty with more overshoot, the Anti-hero crisp). Every ramp is 6 ticks or more (the snappy profile solves on twos: a shorter one reads as a snap). Under reduced motion the lean, bank and breath are 0.5. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. First values, Animation's.
